prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one finished, square desktop application icon for HammeRR, a futuristic 3D level editor for Counter-Strike: Source.
Primary request: a beautiful futuristic, colorful icon with an immediately recognizable hammer emblem and a subtle visual connection to building 3D worlds.
Subject and composition: one bold, chunky geometric hammer, diagonally poised, with a short substantial handle and a broad, unmistakable hammer head made from clean faceted block volumes. Center it prominently inside a midnight navy rounded-square tile, with generous clean separation around the silhouette. A restrained angular wireframe-cube or construction-grid detail can suggest level geometry behind the hammer, remaining subordinate to the emblem.
Style: premium contemporary app icon, sculpted geometric 3D with precise bevels, clean graphic shapes, controlled glossy highlights, exceptionally crisp edges. Sophisticated and energetic rather than toy-like. Beautiful neon cyan, electric blue and magenta color transitions with a small warm orange highlight; rich color separation, deep shadows and clear light-dark contrast. Subtle emissive rim lighting, restrained bloom.
Practical constraints: readable as a distinctive hammer even at 32 pixels; broad surfaces, strong silhouette, minimal small details. One icon only, filling most of the square canvas with even safety padding. The navy rounded-square tile is part of the icon; the area outside its rounded corners must have genuine transparent alpha. No words, no letters, no numerals, no watermark, no presentation mockup, no multiple variants, no surrounding scene. Avoid thin outlines as the main structure, busy circuitry, sparks, particles, and excessive glow.
